title: AI Platform Engineer
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Platform Engineer based in Germany. Join a forward-thinking technology team building the AI platform that powers intelligent agents across multiple business functions, including engineering, business development, compliance, support, and finance. In this hands-on individual contributor role, you will design, develop, and operate the infrastructure that enables AI agents to perform increasingly autonomous tasks safely and reliably. You will work across agent runtimes, integrations, identity management, security guardrails, evaluation frameworks, and observability. Collaborating closely with internal domain experts, you will turn operational challenges into scalable AI-powered solutions that deliver measurable business value. You will take ownership from initial design and implementation through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. This remote-first opportunity is ideal for an experienced engineer who combines strong software fundamentals with practical expertise in deploying and scaling LLM-based systems. Accountabilities You will help build and evolve the organization's AI platform, enabling teams across the business to deploy reliable, secure, and increasingly autonomous agents. Your responsibilities will include: Productionizing AI workflows: Transform prototypes into robust production systems with defined service-level agreements (SLAs), supporting use cases such as specification-to-pull-request agents, AI-powered code reviews, incident triage, and Know Your Business (KYB) reviews. Building and managing MCP servers: Design, deploy, secure, and maintain Model Context Protocol servers, including authentication, per-user OAuth, scoped access, and integrations with tools such as Slack, GitHub, Jira, HubSpot, and internal services. Developing autonomous agents: Build multi-step agents capable of planning and taking action across different tools, progressing through controlled trust stages from shadowing and suggesting to executing tasks autonomously. Implementing security and governance: Establish platform-wide guardrails, including agent identities, scoped credentials, audit logs, CI checks, approval workflows, allowlists, and least-privilege access policies. Creating evaluation frameworks: Develop test datasets, evaluation criteria, regression suites, and live production scoring systems to measure agent quality and connect performance metrics to business outcomes. Improving observability: Instrument agents and workflows with tracing, logging, latency and cost metrics, drift detection, alerts, and dashboards that help internal Operators monitor performance. Managing AI expenditure: Track usage and spending across AI providers, including Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter. Establish budgets, alerts, and cost attribution at the team, agent, and workflow levels. Supporting internal stakeholders: Work directly with Operators across business functions to understand their needs, develop requested features, create documentation, deliver enablement sessions, and build self-service tools. Developing reusable AI capabilities: Create and maintain shared skills, plugins, and knowledge resources covering company processes, standards, security requirements, and brand guidelines. Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them. Taking end-to-end ownership: Write technical specifications, plan and deliver projects independently, communicate progress asynchronously, and remain accountable for monitoring and improving solutions after deployment. Requirements The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building and operating production-ready AI systems. You should be comfortable working independently, communicating with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and applying sound judgment to complex automation and security challenges. Required qualifications include: At least 5 years of experience as a software, platform, or infrastructure engineer, with a solid understanding of system design, data modeling, testing, debugging, and code review. Between 6 and 12 months of experience shipping LLM-based systems to production and supporting agentic workflows used by real end users. Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code. Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks. Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls. Knowledge of identity and access management systems such as Okta or similar identity providers, including SSO protocols (SAML/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, group-based access, and device policies. Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password. Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code. Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring. Practical experience implementing production observability through tracing, metrics, alerting, and dashboards, using tools such as OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog, Langfuse, LangSmith, or Braintrust. Experience monitoring and controlling AI expenditure across providers through API key limits, cost centers, budgets, and actionable alerts. Strong programming skills in at least one of TypeScript, Python, or Go, alongside working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure. A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical specifications, runbooks, and RFCs. Ability to understand stakeholder needs, translate ambiguous requests into actionable technical requirements, and explain complex concepts to both executives and subject matter experts. A proactive and autonomous working style, with the ability to prioritize effectively, challenge unsafe or low-value requests constructively, and communicate progress across time zones. A strong sense of ownership, including the ability to validate solutions with users, monitor performance after deployment, and continuously iterate. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in cryptocurrency, blockchain, payments, or fintech, particularly within regulated or audit-focused environments. Experience creating reusable agent skills, plugins, or shared prompt libraries for organizational use. Familiarity with model gateways such as OpenRouter, LiteLLM, or Portkey, including key management, model routing, and fallback strategies. Experience extending open-source coding agents such as OpenCode or Pi. Awareness of emerging agent identity standards, including MCP enterprise-managed authentication and Okta Cross App Access. Knowledge of context and retrieval engineering, including vector stores, agent memory, and permission-aware retrieval systems. Background in machine learning engineering, including model evaluation, fine-tuning, and model routing. Experience working with agent runtimes and sandbox environments such as Modal, n8n, or containerized infrastructure. Public technical contributions, such as open-source tools, servers, technical articles, or presentations demonstrating experience with production AI agents. Benefits Remote-first work environment: Join a globally distributed workforce and work remotely. Health insurance: Access medical, dental, and vision coverage, with employee and dependent coverage fully provided in certain countries, depending on the applicable plan. Retirement benefits: Benefit from a company-matched 401(k) contribution of up to 3% for eligible employees in the United States. Home office allowance: Receive a one-time allowance of $1,500 to set up your home workspace. Professional development: Access an annual book allowance of $200 to support continuous learning. Connectivity reimbursement: Receive $75 per month toward internet or phone expenses. Flexible time off: Benefit from flexible paid time off arrangements. Work equipment: Receive a company-issued laptop. Well-being support: Access egg-freezing benefits, mental health resources, and employee wellness programs. Inclusive workplace: Work in an environment committed to equal opportunity, accessibility, and providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!  Why Apply Through Jobgether?     Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.     #LI-CL1 Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: AUTOSAR Embedded Software Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Mobileye’s Automotive Software development team is looking for SW developers to work on the cutting-edge of technologies bringing to market Mobileye Autosar self-driving platforms.   We are looking for experienced SW developers with strong debugging skills and Autosar diagnostic experience who are passionately motivated by challenges and excel in troubleshooting complex problems. What will your job look like: Developing and configuring AUTOSAR modules, below the RTE. Creating and implementing software components on top of the RTE. Create design documents, SW requirements, SW unit tests and test cases. Establish bi-directional traceability between SW requirements and SW design. Optimization of the design or code in regards to consumption of resources. Debugging on bench and in vehicle, using Lauterbach debuggers, DLT and XCP. Participate in design and code and requirements reviews. Perform AUTOSAR embedded software integration. Troubleshooting and root cause analysis of issues. Participation in internal, customer, supplier and OEM meetings. Knowledge transfer from and into the development teams. All you need is: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Software Engineering or equivalent technical field from an accredited institution, Masters is a strong advantage. 4 years of experience on Embedded Software in automotive electrical & electronics industry AUTOSAR expertise, Adaptive AUTOSAR is an advantage. Strong customer orientation, willingness to meet deadlines, and self-management skills. Deep passion for solving problems to resolution, including root cause analysis skills. Ability to work and collaborate in a dynamic and global team environment and adapt to changing priorities and customer needs.   Nice to have: Knowledge of scripting tools like Python, CAPL. Experience with software engineering tools (JIRA, GIT). Experience with UDS protocol / Bootloader / OEM Specific. Advanced experience with NXP processors and QNX OS. Advanced experience with AUTOSAR abstraction (Mcu, Wdg, Gpt, Dio, Port, Icu, …). Advanced experience with AUTOSAR BSW and RTE, architecture, specifications, and configuration tools (eg. ElektroBitTresOs, Vector DaVinci). Strong fundamentals programming in C, embedded system concepts, and software build process. Experience with software engineering process models (Automotive Spice (ISO 15504), Functional Safety (ISO 26262), Agile, MISRA C). Experience with Vector products (CANoe, CANape, vFlash, vT Family). Experience with debugging methods and tools (e.g., Lauterbach Trace32). Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Platform Engineer
description: About finmid At finmid, we’re building infrastructure that integrates access to capital for SMEs directly into the platforms they use daily. We leverage technology, data, and strategic partnerships to deliver financing solutions that significantly outperform traditional financial services - offering SMEs faster, simpler, and more transparent access to funding. As we expand across Europe, our Latvian subsidiary, licensed as a European Crowdfunding Service Provider by the Bank of Latvia, plays a critical role. Our stack combines regulated financial infrastructure with modern software engineering. The gap between those two things is exactly where this role lives. The Role We're looking for a Platform Engineer who wants to own the infrastructure that makes everything else possible. You'll build and maintain the systems our engineering teams rely on every day — CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, data tooling, AI integrations, and developer experience as a whole. This isn't a "keep the lights on" role. You'll design systems from scratch, introduce new tools, and have a direct say in how we build software. What You Will Work On Architect and manage our cloud infrastructure on AWS and Kubernetes. Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling, and internal platforms. Evaluate, integrate, and roll out new tools and services across the company. Partner with product and business teams to remove bottlenecks and ship faster. Own production systems end-to-end — from design decisions to incident response. Raise the bar on security, observability, and engineering standards. What you need to be successful We care far more about how you think than what you already know. Languages and tools can be learned — curiosity and drive can't. You're a pragmatist. You find the simplest solution that actually works, not the most impressive one. You're comfortable with infrastructure. You have hands-on experience with containers, orchestration, and cloud platforms (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, or similar). You write clean, maintainable code. We mostly work in Kotlin and TypeScript, but we won't filter you out over a language. You communicate well. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people and collaborate across teams without friction. You want to grow. You're not looking for a role where you do the same thing every day. You want to stretch. Bonus points for Experience with financial services, payments, or regulated environments. Familiarity with managing micro-services running on JVM runtime. A track record of driving projects from idea to production. Experience working in distributed / remote teams. Benefits We see ourselves as “distributed first” but also have a beautiful office in Berlin where you can work. We are flexible and cover whatever you need to be as productive as possible (e.g., MacOS, IntelliJ IDEA, Claude Code). Home office stipend. 30 days’ of time off. Meaningful equity. Open-minded and transparent culture that includes regular get-together meetings (e.g., All Hands, Brown Bag Lunch, Offsites). Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Software Provisioning Technician (m/f/d) - UGV
description: As a Software Provisioning Technician UGV (m/f/d), you will be part of our production team for unmanned ground systems at our Göppingen site and will be responsible for the software deployment, configuration, and release of Mandrill UGVs and future LAND platforms. You will ensure that every vehicle is delivered with the correct, approved software configuration, playing a key role in transforming our LAND production from prototype-based manufacturing into a robust, repeatable, and scalable serial production environment. You will work hands-on with the vehicles while collaborating closely with Software/Firmware Engineering, Quality, Testing, and Production teams. In this role, you will follow approved work instructions, ensure full traceability of all activities, and actively contribute shop floor feedback to the continuous improvement of provisioning processes. What is your Day to Day Mission: Install, configure, and flash firmware and software onto control units, onboard computers, and subsystems of Mandrill UGVs in accordance with approved work instructions. Perform software and configuration verification as part of end-of-line and system testing procedures. Manage and document software versions, configuration baselines, and release statuses while ensuring complete traceability in Operations1. Conduct fault analysis and troubleshooting for software and configuration issues, escalating deviations through the defined quality and deviation management process. Support the introduction of new software releases, configuration variants, and provisioning tools in close collaboration with Engineering. Actively contribute to validation builds and Low-Rate Initial Production (LRIP) ramp-up activities related to software provisioning processes. Provide shop floor feedback to improve provisioning workflows, tooling, and automation. Work closely with Software/Firmware Engineering, Quality, Testing, and Production teams to ensure smooth handovers and rapid issue resolution. Maintain a safe, clean, and efficient workplace while adhering to all relevant ESD and site-specific regulations. What you bring to the team: You have completed vocational training in a technical or IT-related field, for example as an Electronics Technician for Devices and Systems, Mechatronics Technician, IT Systems Electronics Technician, IT Specialist, or have a comparable qualification. Alternatively, you have several years of relevant professional experience in software provisioning, system integration, production testing, or embedded systems. You have hands-on experience installing, flashing, and configuring firmware and software on control units, onboard computers, or comparable embedded systems. You have experience working with flashing, diagnostic, provisioning, and configuration tools. You are able to systematically analyze errors based on error messages, log files, and test results. You are confident working with technical work instructions, testing requirements, and approved software and configuration versions. You document completed work steps and results digitally with a high degree of accuracy and completeness. You have a strong sense of quality and responsibility and are prepared to stop processes when deviations occur and escalate them through the appropriate channels. You work in a structured, independent, and reliable manner, with strong attention to detail. You communicate openly and professionally and enjoy collaborating with Software Engineering, Testing, Quality, and Production teams. You have good German and English skills, enabling you to work with technical documentation and in an international environment. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. Corporate Benefits: Your opportunity for attractive offers and discounts from well-known suppliers and brands, e.g. Adidas, Apple, Expedia. Employee events: We not only want to grow together, but also celebrate our successes together. About us: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. At Quantum Systems, you’ll work alongside experts across disciplines, take ownership from day one and help turn ambitious ideas into technology with real-world impact. We move fast, think beyond boundaries and give our teams the space to shape what comes next. The Future is Unmanned - But the responsibility is not. Our commitment: We are an open-minded company that not only values diversity, but actively promotes it. Regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation or disability, we firmly believe that the diversity of our employees is an essential part of our success. At our company, every voice is heard and every perspective is valued. We believe that our differences enrich us and help us to find creative solutions and generate innovative ideas. title: Advisory Data Architect
description: About Unity Advisory Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO, with connected solutions across finance, deals and tax. Focussed on client outcomes, seasoned experts lead every engagement, in an operating model powered by AI and free from audit conflict. The Role We are looking for an experienced Advisory Data Architect to own data design across our advisory engagements. This is a platform and design-authority role with a hands-on edge, combining finance-focused business understanding with modern data architecture, platforms and governance. You will define how data - across a client’s business - is structured, governed, and served so that AI, analytics, and management reporting are reliable and scalable. As a Senior Manager, you will lead architecture decisions, guide engineers, shape client data strategy, architecture, governance, and be accountable for the coherence and quality of the data estate you design. This is a client-facing role within our AI Advisory team, setting the data architecture that our engagements — and our clients' AI ambitions — are built on. Key Responsibilities Define target-state data architectures for clients — models, storage, pipelines, and access patterns — balancing rigour with delivery realism. Establish data modelling standards and curated domain layers across the a variety of systems (e.g. ERP, CRM, Manufacturing) and data sources, with end-to-end lineage and provenance sufficient for audit and controls. Map and integrate finance source systems (ERP, EPM, sub-ledgers, and consolidation tools) into governed, analytics-ready models. Design the finance data foundations for applied AI/ML: governed retrieval sources for RAG, feature stores, and the architecture that keeps AI systems fed with trustworthy, reconciled finance data. Set patterns for secure, compliant finance data platforms — access control, data sensitivity, segregation of duties, isolation, and alignment to standards such as ISO 27001. Provide architectural direction for cloud data platforms, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and observability, ensuring designs are cost-aware and operable. Define the data lineage and controls that support responsible production AI — monitoring, confidence scoring, and human-in-the-loop review. Translate ambiguous business and client problems into clear architectural decisions and scoped roadmaps under delivery pressure. Own key technical trade-offs and communicate them clearly to engineers, product stakeholders, and senior client sponsors. Mentor data engineers, raise the technical bar across the team, and contribute reusable patterns, reference architectures, and accelerators. What We're Looking For Essential Significant experience designing and delivering data architectures for production systems, with evidence that your designs have shipped and run - not remained on paper. Deep expertise in data modelling, warehouse/lakehouse design, and data governance. Hands-on background in SQL and Python, and fluency with at least one major cloud provider (AWS or Azure) and modern data platforms (e.g. Snowflake, Databricks). System-level judgement on how data architecture shapes AI outcomes: designing governed sources for RAG, structuring data for retrieval and orchestration, and deciding where structured outputs and tool use fit. Ability to set standards and lead engineers while remaining close to implementation. Strong stakeholder skills, including engaging senior client sponsors and explaining architectural trade-offs clearly. Strong Preference Experience architecting the data layer behind AI or analytics products in production. Informed views on the trade-offs between fine-tuning, RAG, and long-context approaches, and how each changes data architecture requirements, including context window economics and prompt caching. Familiarity with infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and observability for data platforms. Awareness of MCP and tool-orchestration concepts and their implications for composable, data-driven AI systems. Fluent use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor), with a clear view of where they help and where human design judgement must lead. Security and compliance experience (e.g. ISO 27001 alignment, access control design). Consulting or advisory background, owning problems end-to-end rather than a single workstream. Nice to Have Evidence of self-directed building — side projects, internal tools, or startups. Exposure to finance data, PE/M&A, or portfolio-company environments. Relevant certifications (e.g. AWS/Azure architect-level credentials). Additional Information We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. Driving process automation: Proactively identify repetitive manual workflows that could benefit from AI, implement automation solutions, measure their impact, and continuously improve them. Daily, hands-on experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code and Codex to write, test, and review production code. Experience developing autonomous or multi-step agents with tool integrations, using technologies such as the Claude Agent SDK, Anthropic APIs, OpenAI APIs, or similar frameworks. Practical experience building MCP servers, including OAuth authentication flows, scoped tokens, and user-level access controls. Experience creating automated system identities, including GitHub Apps, service accounts, API keys, and managing secrets through tools such as 1Password. Understanding of security guardrails and governance practices, including least-privilege access, audit logging, CI checks, approval gates, allowlists, and policy-as-code. Experience designing evaluation systems for LLM applications, including test sets, evaluation rubrics, CI regression testing, release gates, and live production scoring. A demonstrated ability to independently identify and automate manual processes, supported by two or three concrete examples of previous work. Define and document finance KPI definitions in our KPI catalog — formulas, inclusions, exclusions, owners, and sources — to a standard that withstands external review. Automate what is manual today: turn recurring spreadsheet work, audit packs, and month-end routines into repeatable processes that largely run themselves. Experience in a start-up or scale-up environment is preferred. Who You Are You are precise, and you are curious about where a number came from before you are comfortable reporting it — whether that means reading the ledger or querying the lakehouse. You know the difference between a figure that looks right and a figure that can be traced back to its source, and you care about the second one. title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
description: Functie  Reliability engineer   Beschrijving functie   De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.   De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren.  Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.   Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn. Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf. Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.
